item.title: [경제] 글로벌 금융시장 주요 지표 및 통화 정책 동향
item.description: 워런 버핏의 버크셔 회장직 퇴임 소식과 함께 미국 8월 경기선행지수(전월비 0.1%↓) 및 제조업 생산(0.3% 감소)이 예상치를 하회했습니다. 영란은행(BOE)은 기준금리를 3.75%로 동결했으며, 달러-원 환율은 뉴욕장에서 1,380원대 후반에 거래되었습니다. 또한 일본은행(BOJ) 정책 변화에 따른 엔화 변동성과 유럽중앙은행(ECB)의 통화정책 방향이 주목받았습니다.

item.title: [경제] 달러-엔 환율 급락 및 미국 경제 지표 둔화 양상
item.description: 달러-엔 환율이 장중 156엔대까지 급락했으며, 미국의 8월 제조업 생산이 0.3% 감소하고 경기선행지수가 0.1% 하락하는 등 경제 지표가 시장 전망치를 하회했습니다. 한편, 워런 버핏이 버크셔 회장직에서 물러나 명예회장으로 추대되었습니다.

item.title: [생활] Talk less, listen more and six other top tips on giving good advice
item.description: Are you someone who thinks they have all the answers? Is your experience relevant here? Experts on the questions to ask yourself before giving advice“Often, when people approach you for advice, they just want to talk about how they feel,” says Annalisa Barbieri, advice columnist for the Guardian for almost 20 years. For example, you might vent to a friend about your awful boss, and if they’re shocked it could confirm you’re being treated badly. “I also think people can have a lot of shame when things aren’t working out, and we like to share shame because it’s a hot potato of a feeling.” In other words, not every situation warrants advice. Sometimes, the person just wants to gauge a reaction or to share. Continue reading...

item.title: [문화] ‘The man’s a psychopath when it comes to hedgerows’: Derek vs Derek, the unexpectedly heartwarming doc about farmers at war
item.description: One Devon farmer, called Derek, is committed to rewilding his land. His neighbour, also a Derek, tends cattle and crops. What happened when a film-maker decided to follow the bickering pair?Derek Gow and Derek Banbury should hate each other. Gow is an outspoken rewilder widely credited with bringing back the beaver in England. As he returns his Devon sheep farm to wild nature, he is also breeding storks, wildcats, red-backed shrikes, glowworms and even adders to return to the countryside. Over the hedge, Banbury, his neighbour, is proud to be an intensive farmer, producing milk and beef cattle behind tightly clipped hedges.“It’s like he’s just gone mad,” says Banbury of Gow at the start of Derek vs Derek, an illuminating and unexpectedly funny new documentary that follows the pair over three years. “And the madness is now crossing the road on to my land.” Continue reading...

item.title: [생활] Legends of the fall: why autumn is the perfect time to plant grasses in your garden
item.description: Whether tall or short, wafty or heavy, these versatile, texture-giving plants can be magicalAfter four long months of warmth, the garden decided it was autumn prematurely. Yellow leaves piled up against the kerbstones. Everything might be dry and crispy, but for those who believe that planting should be done between September and April, it’s the start of a whole new school term in the garden.I won’t be planting anything just yet: my garden is currently home to steel girders and a cement mixer. Instead, I’ve been taking inspiration from other green spaces: other people’s gardens, parks, allotments and community growing spaces are far more interesting than mine. And when you can’t garden in your own plot, gardens become even more addictive. Which is why grasses are on my mind: my son was running through our well-landscaped local play park yesterday morning, the sun was low and yolky, and the seedheads were shimmering. Yes, I thought, I need more of these. Continue reading...
